children.text: These clips function as a way to build up hype for the show itself. The clips itself show an emotionally charged moment on this Reality TV show, but to an outside viewer who hasn't seen the show won't know the context behind why the girls are arguing. It engages viewers by "picking a side," and entices outsiders to watch Love island to understand why people are choosing a side. Functioning as an ad for Love island.
The virality of the short clips that are chosen aid companies like Peacock to function as an ad for their TV Shows or movies.

Love Island is incredibly popular, but Love Island turns contestants into products. This clip favorites two specific contestants and is able to monetize off of them. The contestants become forms of advertising capital from their individual social media accounts to sponserships. The people and the media become raw material for commercial content.

Beauty in Love Island reinforces the idea that it is economic value espcially with the competitve twist of playing for money this show has. Attractive bodies are desierable and rewarded within the rules of the show. After the show the contestants apperance is part of their income-generating potential.

You, the audience, becomes part of the marketplace. Love Island encourages viewers to be active by downloading a specific app and voting on contestants couples. Viewers engage with social media and forums discussing the show transforming the attention into generating a profit.
